self.title: Prebiotic Copying Fidelity and Error Thresholds

detail.title: Prebiotic Copying Fidelity and Error Thresholds
detail.question: What minimum copying fidelity and error thresholds govern the stability of heritable chemical information in prebiotic systems?
detail.reason: We have collected source material regarding error thresholds and replicator dynamics to examine the boundary where chemical information can be reliably inherited.
